Parker Jordan takes Anna into the club, but crisis strikes again when the ruthless “Go King”Owl storms in for a showdown.Calm and unstoppable, Anna dismantles Owl’s attacks move by move, forcing the defeated king to his knees—begging to become her disciple.When the dust settles, Parker Jordan confides in Anna his lifelong obsession: entering the legendary “Zenith Go Championship” to uncover the truth behind his wife’s death. And so—their fated journey begins.

when-she-stopped-chasing-his-love.copied_text:
Camellia was born with a gift for piano, but after losing hearing in one ear, her family gave up on her.
To keep chasing music, she accepted Dylan’s help—and became the stand-in for the woman he truly loved: her sister, Malory.
Three years later, Malory returns. Camellia finally sees the truth and decides to leave.
But when she walks away, a mysterious music producer sees her talent.
And Dylan begins to realize… he lost the wrong woman.

the-billionaires-rescue.copied_text:
After their encounter, he became a patron saint to protect her all the time.
Emily works tirelessly at a bar to save money for college, but her life takes a dark turn when she's assaulted by a customer. In her darkest moment, Luke heroically intervenes, saving her and sparking a deep emotional connection between them. Initially determined to raise her unexpected child alone, Emily reconsiders when Luke reappears, offering unwavering support and love. Their budding romance faces a formidable challenge with the sudden reemergence of Luke’s ex-fiancée, Clara, who is bent on tearing them apart. The stakes rise when Clara uncovers a shocking secret: Emily is the true heiress of the Cassano family, switched at birth in a malicious plot. Desperate to keep this secret, Clara schemes against Emily, but her plans ultimately unravel.Reclaimed by her rightful family, Emily witnesses Clara face the consequences of her actions. Amidst the revelations and justice, Emily and Luke's love triumphs. They celebrate their journey with a grand wedding, their story becoming a legend of enduring love and resilience, as they step into a blissful married life together.

a-flash-marriage-with-the-billionaire-ty.copied_text: Elise was a normal accountant of Hawthorn Group. She worked very carefully to avoid any problem, but she made a huge mistake despite of her caution. She was on a business trip and was drunk, then she accidentally had an one-night stand with her boss Lucian. Her fate had changed since then...

justice-in-blood.copied_text:
Five years ago, he lost everything—family, love, and a life he once knew.
Now he’s back, forged by blood and fire. He walks straight into the city’s darkest syndicate… and takes it apart from the inside. Because this time, justice isn’t clean—and neither is he.

married-to-a-fisherman-but-he-is-poseido.copied_text: In her past life, Aloryn was killed after marrying First Prince Adrian. Reborn with a second chance, she rejects her family’s control and chooses to marry Neptune, a fisherman despised by everyone around her. Though they live a poor but peaceful life, the Sea God’s Festival draws them into conflicts involving the royal family, House Sterling, and the Sea Temple. Even as her family humiliates and torments her, Aloryn remains kind and steadfast. When she faces danger, the Mother of Gods, Rhea, appears to test her, while Neptune’s true identity is finally revealed: he is actually Poseidon, the Sea God. In the end, Aloryn earns divine recognition, becomes Queen of the Seven Seas, and rules beside Poseidon.

dragonfire-and-the-sacred-sword.copied_text: The overlooked Princess Aelia Aelin draws the Sacred Sword, forms a Lifebound Covenant with a young dragon Silvermoon, frees the enslaved dragons, defeats the tyrant Mordes, and ultimately becomes Queen of Aelin.

almost-lover.copied_text: Evelyn returns from her prenatal checkup to find her husband massaging oil onto his first love's belly. When Evelyn suffers a severe allergic reaction, he locks her in a room and ignores her pain—she loses the baby. Shattered, she walks away and rebuilds at her friend's architecture firm. Months later, Edward finds her at the love-lock bridge where they vowed forever, threatening to jump unless she forgives him. Will Evelyn save the man who destroyed her, or let him fall?

christmas-with-a-country-bad-boy.copied_text: After a sold-out world tour, country music’s good girl returns home for Christmas to rest—only to be cornered by her money-hungry family pressuring her to sign away her estate. When her label sends its scandal-ridden bad boy to rehab his image, she least expects him to be the one who helps her fight back, reclaim her voice, and take control of her life again.

escape-with-boss-s-baby.copied_text: Hermione Garcia is a famous computer genius and the heiress to the Garcia family,the wealthiest family in the South. She falls in love with Chris Evans, the President of LM Corporation, after he saves her at a banquet three years ago. To seek a genuine connection, Hermione conceals her identity and takes on the role of Chris's chief secretary, secretly dating him for three years.

food-love-robots.copied_text: Seven years after her soulmate Elliot’s sudden death, Lily’s quiet Christmas is upended when her and Elliot’s son Evan’s wish comes true: Elliot returns. But this Elliot is a humanoid robot, programmed with her late boyfriend’s memories. As Lily’s heart reopens to love, she must navigate the charming chaos of family, romance, and technology, discovering whether this second chance at happiness is real or just a perfect AI program.

the-hockey-star-s-ramoree.copied_text: Six years ago, nerdy Evie spent a magical night with her crush,  hockey star Timothy—only to learn it was all a bet. Now a successful producer, she crosses paths with him again. In front of reporters, Timothy publicly apologizes and reveals he's been waiting for Evie ever since. Within an hour, #FindEvie is trending at number one.

the-fiery-young-marshal.copied_text: Song Shuangxu was abandoned by her parents since childhood. It was Shen Yu who took her home and raised her like a princess. She misunderstood her dependence on Shen Yu as love. After being discovered by the Shen family, she was'sent' abroad for many years. After returning, the Shen family was framed by their opponents. To repay the kindness of upbringing, Song Shuangxu became the secret lover of He Tingzhou, the young master of Yancheng. What she didn't know was that He Tingzhou had a crush on her for many years and had long planned it. In the process, He Tingzhou's meticulous care for Song Shuangxu touched her and also made her understand what true love is.

starlight-redemption.copied_text: Lin Qingzhu, a gifted architecture student, is pushed to the brink when her mother is critically ill. Faced with humiliation from Chu Guanxing, who uses medical expenses as leverage, Lin Qingzhu accepts an unexpected bargain proposed by his uncle, Chu Nanhe. Confined to a wheelchair, Chu Nanhe only asks her to share dinner with him every day in exchange for her mother’s treatment. Being the young power holder of the Chu family, Chu Nanhe is distant yet refined. He covers her mother’s medical costs, guides Lin Qingzhu’s growth, offers her meticulous protection, and steps forward whenever she is questioned or wronged. The tacit understanding and care between them soon surpasses anything ordinary. Yet behind Chu Nanhe’s gentle guardianship, there seems to lie an enormous secret.

spring-night-s-fiery-kisses.copied_text: Li Chuchu's younger sister was forced to commit suicide by three rich young men, and her mother was beaten into a vegetative state. Since then, Li Chuchu has dropped out of school and entered the Cloud Peak Club, all to attach herself to Pei Qingji, the person in power in Jinggang, to get her revenge. In this act of using him, she pretended to be weak and planned carefully step by step. And yet, she unexpectedly fell for him when he continued to aggressively dote on her.

all-about-secretary-li.copied_text: Li Weixi, an elite “hunter” among the highly educated, disguises herself as a harmless, innocent secretary and infiltrates the side of Jia He, the president of the Jia Group. Her goal is to expose the truth that he abandoned his own sister and drag him down from his pedestal. But Jia He, a calculating CEO, has long seen through her disguise and decides to keep her close. He indulges her little schemes, watches her act, and even helps cover up her lies. The two circle each other in constant testing and tension. Just as Li Weixi is about to succeed, trouble comes one after another, throwing her into chaos. Most unexpected of all, her supposed enemy Jia He repeatedly steps in to protect her. As her desire for revenge begins to waver, a misunderstanding breaks her heart and drives her away.Li Weixi’s complete disappearance sends Jia He into a downward spiral. Abandoning his wealth, he sets off on a warm yet comedic pursuit to win her back in the countryside. In the end, the secrets of the past are revealed, and all grudges fade away. He gives up his powerful family for love, while she transforms from an avenger into a lover. In a game that began with lies, the two ultimately achieve mutual redemption.

the-choices-of-fate.copied_text: After their mother’s death, Kate and Amelia Morse face a cruel choice—only one can leave with their grieving grandmother. Believing wealth awaits, Amelia departs, only to find an ordinary life. Years later, envy consumes her when Kate marries into the wealthy Warren family. In a fit of rage, she kills her sister before taking her own life.

victory-in-love.copied_text: Lin Zhanhong, the queen of the workplace, and Wen Yushi, the "newly appointed director," start as weekend lovers with a deal: cooperation only, no feelings involved. As they stand together against internal power plays at the company, their arrangement slowly turns into real love. When Wen's hidden identity as the "company heir" and a formidable love rival come to light, they face a crisis of trust. But through it all, they confirm their true feelings, tear down their defenses, and emerge victorious in love and work.

bright-moon-of-spring-night.copied_text: At the anniversary celebration of Zhongtai Law Firm, law student Wen Yue accidentally ends up helping Jiang Hansheng, a lawyer experiencing a sudden episode due to trauma. Since witnessing his mother’s death as a child, Jiang Hansheng has been deeply tormented. Later, he catches Wen Yue’s boyfriend, Liang Xiao, cheating on her, stirring up ripples in his already unsettled heart. Determined to expose the truth of the affair, Jiang Hansheng offers to help Wen Yue while pretending to be her new boyfriend, thus beginning their unexpected bond. As their connection deepens, Wen Yue gradually uncovers the secrets behind Jiang Hansheng’s family background. Together, they begin to heal, finding redemption and comfort in each other’s arms.

love-s-trenches.copied_text: Mia Bale, the daughter of the wealthiest family, works as an intern in her family's company. Unexpectedly, she encounters Ken Leed, the CEO of a collaborating company who is also her former boyfriend, having vanished without explanation three years ago. As Mia tries to reconcile with Ken, she faces obstacles from Lily Cork, who exacerbates misunderstandings between them.

embrace-you-through-the-ashes.copied_text: Jiang Wu has always lived in fear of debt collectors due to her father's disappearance, until she meets Jiang Yan, a silent man always covered in wounds, who takes her in and protects her. What she does not know is that he is actually an undercover police officer named Lu Xiao, who has infiltrated a border town gang incognito. The two lonely souls grow closer, yet she can never see through the mist in his eyes. At a critical juncture of his mission, he leaves without a word, leaving only some money and a letter telling her to forget him. Four years later, she becomes a reporter for North City TV, while he, retired due to injuries, runs a homestay called "Yearning for Wu." Fate brings them together again—she arrives with an interview list, and he calmly says he is Lu Xiao. Be it Jiang Yan or Lu Xiao, he remains an indelible part of her life. After years of hating him and searching for him, she now realizes that him keeping secrets and pushing her away are just to protect her.

start-from-scratch.copied_text: Wen Shiyi, the once-prosperous young heiress, has no choice but to be the fiancée of playboy Fu Yixuan. Desperate to break free, she sets her sights on Yixuan's uncle, Fu Shen, the one who truly holds sway in the Fu family. She thinks her seduction plot is going smoothly, when in fact every seemingly coincidental encounter and flirtation is orchestrated by Shen, as he recognized her as the beloved he has been searching for all these years. He weaves a web of love not to ensnare her but to teach her the meaning of loving and being loved, making himself her strongest support.

dark-light.copied_text:
Qin Yulin, a driver for Xingyao Group, woke up in the bed of Xu Enxin, the heiress of the prestigious Fenghua Chamber of Commerce, after what seemed like a chance encounter in the bar.

Captivated by him, Xu Enxin requested him from Xingyao Group’s CEO, Zhou Xinghan. Thus, Qin Yulin became her driver. He quietly memorized all her preferences, handed her the perfect cup of coffee when she was tired, and shielded her from every sign of danger. Xu Enxin gradually found herself growing increasingly reliant on this "driver." But in truth, Qin Yulin carried a deep, blood-soaked vendetta. 18 years ago, the Zhou family was responsible for the death of his parents and bound him to them with an 80-year contract. Approaching the Xu heiress was supposed to be the most crucial move in his revenge plan. But somewhere along the way, he fell in love with the proud yet pure-hearted young lady.

The truth, however, is always cruel. When Xu Enxin discovered Qin Yulin’s true motives, she chose to accept a political engagement with Zhou Xinghan. And when Qin Yulin learned that the woman he loved was to marry another, all he could do was silently protect her from the shadows. Caught in the tug-of-war between deception and sincerity, how could a love that began with calculation possibly continue?

At the engagement banquet, Qin Yulin tore off his disguise and exposed the Zhou family’s crimes, while Xu Enxin revealed her own trump card. It turns out the entire “lovers turned enemies” drama had been their silent, mutual plan all along.

In the end, the villains were brought to justice, and Qin Yulin finally held her in his arms openly. All those moments of feigned indifference and distant affection melt at last into a single passionate kiss.

of-his-day-and-night.copied_text: Andrologist Tessa Tilden marries Jordan Slate to save her mother—only to be ensnared in a web of family intrigue. On their wedding night, she encounters Simon Slate, discovering later that he is Jordan's alternate persona, born from a childhood trauma seventeen years ago. As Tessa unravels the kidnapping plot behind it all, she and Jordan join forces to expose his uncle Marcel Slate and restore both love and peace to the Slate family.

moving-on-from-you.copied_text:
Jane Rowe has been in love with Sam Bale ever since he took her in at the age of seven. Every year on her birthday, she confesses her feelings, only to be rejected as Sam, believing their ten-year age gap is too large, chooses someone else.
One night, they get drunk and spend the night together, but Sam has no recollection of it. When Jane becomes pregnant, Sam accuses her of being indecent. Heartbroken, Jane leaves him to continue his life with his girlfriend.

accidentally-wooing-you.copied_text: Tian Yiyi's infatuation with Gu Xuan stems from a creative fascination. She views him as the blueprint for the male lead in her novel on a superficial level. An email—accidentally sent with her novel draft attached instead of her resignation letter—leads Gu to believe she is making a move on him. To discern her true intentions, he keeps her by his side under the guise of a probation period. She desperately tries to clear things up, which he misinterprets as playing hard to get. Yet, beneath the misunderstandings, a genuine connection blossoms. When she falls ill, he simmers porridge late into the night; when he is exhausted, a casual remark from her resolves his work dilemmas. Lines blur as her heart races when she is right next to him in the elevator and she cannot stop staring as he cooks for her—is she falling for the domineering CEO persona she has written or for the man who furrows his brows over the precise heat needed for the porridge? He, too, is falling for her—her candor at investment meetings, the fatigue evident as she rubs her neck during late-night work sessions, and the sparkle in her eyes when she writes—every facet of her lowers his emotional guard. When he loses his composure out of jealousy over the way she looks at Zhao Chengchen and proposes by the seaside with fireworks and a ring, she accepts without hesitation. She professes her love for him, clarifying that she merely admires Zhao professionally. When she decides to quit her job and pursue her dream of writing, he supports her without reservation. Ultimately, this relationship born of a mistake has led her to a true love rooted in mutual fulfillment.

the-seventh-year-of-pending-love.copied_text: Cheng Xia has been in love with Chen Shechuan, whom she grew up with, and their seven years together are filled with romantic tension. After an accidental drunken kiss, Shechuan rejects Xia, claiming they are just good friends, when really, he is emotionally avoidant because of his parents' failed marriage. To make her give up, he introduces his girlfriend Jiang Yining when he visits her house, and even sets her up with a blind date, under the guise of doing her a favor. Heartbroken, she resolves to move on from this vague situationship...

a-dash-of-sweetness.copied_text: The story follows Shi Yin, a wealthy heiress who appears gentle but is in fact resolute, and Han Zhan, a wealthy young master who is cold to outsiders but clingy and affectionate toward her. They meet by chance while fleeing an assassination attempt and save each other. Living side by side afterward, Shi Yin dotes on Han Zhan as feelings blossom between them. Together, they protect one another and grow hand in hand amid the whirlpool of power and love.

survive-and-thrive-the-mute-consort.copied_text: In her tumultuous childhood, Everly Swan and her mother endured relentless bullying and oppression at the hands of the matriarch, who even resorted to poisoning Everly, leaving her mute. Yet, in her darkest hour, a simple shared piece of candy sparks an unbreakable bond of friendship between two innocent children.Years later, driven by a fierce desire to protect her mother, Everly seeks high status, only to have her dignity trampled underfoot by her cruel half-sister.

depth-of-love.copied_text: Secretary Song, who is usually strict in his work, passionately kissed CEO Jiang Tingzhou after learning that he was in the late stage of cancer. Since then, Jiang Tingzhou has become addicted to Song Xi. To end their casual relationship, Song Xi submitted his resignation the next day. 'CEO, I'm not very satisfied with your performance. Let's part amicably.' Later, at the depth of love, Jiang Tingzhou would always ask Song Xi, 'Are you satisfied?'

no-one-but-you.copied_text: Song Yanzhi accidentally discovers her boyfriend cheating with a wealthy woman and gets drunk in sorrow, mistakenly sleeping with the cold-faced CEO Jiang Yancheng. Jiang Yancheng's arranged marriage partner, Shen Zhiyi, is imprisoned for drunk driving, making the marriage impossible. To secure the cooperation between the Jiang and Shen families, Jiang Yancheng proposes that Song Yanzhi pretend to be Shen Zhiyi to complete the marriage. Thus begins a story of love after wedding between the substitute bride and the CEO.

heart-throb-fortune.copied_text: 22-year-old graduate student Ran Xing is forced to impersonate the psychic "Mr. Moon" and infiltrate the wealthy Ye family to complete a mission of stealing a toothbrush, after her sister is imprisoned. In the process, she must navigate the complex identity of her boyfriend Pu Yubai, the internal family conflicts of the Ye family, and the constant probing of Ye Zhaoning. Through crises and misunderstandings, Ran Xing gradually earns Ye Zhaoning's trust and discerns the truth of her own emotions. Eventually, Ran Xing confesses her true identity, cuts ties with Pu Yubai, and chooses to stand on her own to complete her studies and career. Three years later, she becomes a psychological counselor, helping others heal, while reuniting with a matured Ye Zhaoning, breaking through class barriers and past misunderstandings to start a new chapter in their relationship.

every-thought-every-love-is-you.copied_text: Ellis Hill is known for being cold and aloof, so no one ever suspected that his marriage pact involved Claire Newton. Everyone is therefore stunned when he fills in her name as his wife. Claire had assumed their relationship would remain purely nominal, making it all the more surprising when he begins to shower her with love and tender care after their marriage.

divorce-my-happily-ever-after.copied_text: Betrayed by her husband and his mistress while five months pregnant, Rosie Turner is cast out in humiliation despite having sacrificed everything for him. After the divorce, she finds new strength in Andrew Jaffe, a young and charismatic CEO who not only helps her seek revenge but also supports her rise to success. With him by her side, Rosie discovers both triumph in her career and lasting happiness in love.

midsummer-s-vendela.copied_text: Independent photographer Bai Qingmei is forced into an engagement with Zhou Sheng’an, the president of Hengtai Group. Resisting the chains of marriage, she lays down her ground rules and dismisses him as a dull, middle-aged man. Yet Zhou Sheng’an, with quiet patience, carries her shoes, prepares brown sugar water, and learns to cook, gradually melting the walls around her heart.\NHaunted by her mother’s tragic past and her own fear of “open relationships,” Bai Qingmei mistakes Zhou Sheng’an’s tolerance for indifference and ruthlessly calls off the engagement. After their separation, the frivolous advances of Zhang Jiuwan make her realize where her true feelings lie, while Zhou Sheng’an strikes back with thunderous resolve to protect her. He chases her all the way to Jingbei to propose, but she still struggles with hesitation.\NThrough cycles of avoidance, unexpected reunions, and passion breaking through restraint, she finally recognizes Zhou Sheng’an’s unwavering devotion, his quiet love shown in keeping her clothes, studying photography books, and turning down work just to stay by her side. With the warmth of the Zhou family, Bai Qingmei steps out of the shadows, embracing a love that shatters cold rules with its depth and fidelity.\NIn the height of summer, like the blooming of the vendela roses, their love finally blossoms for each other.

the-penthouse-club.copied_text: Zhong Xian, driven by the tragic death of her sister who depended on her, is drawn into the fierce rivalries of a powerful aristocratic family. Navigating the conflicts between Qin Hao and his son Qin Lang, she uses herself as bait and risks her life as a gamble, stirring up strife between father and son. However, through the intense power struggles, Qin Feng gradually falls into a downward spiral. In the end, Zhong Xian realizes that the grudges and betrayals within the noble family are far more complex than they seem, and she herself is merely a pawn in Qin Hao’s game. Just when she believes her revenge has succeeded, the real storm of bloodshed and chaos is only just beginning.

ceo-s-arrange-bride.copied_text: The story tells the emotional journey of designer Shi Sheng and entrepreneur Yu Wenzhou, who got married in a flash through a blind date. Their relationship developed from a union of interests to one of mutual understanding and love. With a dual-line narrative, the story intertwines workplace interactions and family life, showing the growth trajectory of the two, from tentative adaptation to planning for the future.

affectionate-seduction.copied_text: Lin Yuxi's parents are killed when she is six years old, and she is sent to a welfare home. When she finds out her parents' death is related to the Zhou family, she marries their second son Zhou Yanjing. The two face many misunderstandings and obstacles, such as mistakenly assuming that the other has someone else they love. Once the misunderstandings are resolved, Yanjing starts pursuing Yuxi by setting fireworks with her name, confessing through a fake interview, and installing distance sensors on their watches. Eventually, they find true love in each other.

answer-to-my-heart.copied_text: For years, Cecelia Collins lived in silence, forced to pretend she could not speak. During a kidnapping, she mistakenly believes Ivan Justice doesn't want her unborn child. To protect the baby, she poses as the kidnapper, drawing him into a tense game of confrontation. As their misunderstandings unravel, Cecelia, encouraged by him, finds the courage to speak—and to follow her heart.

a-tragedy-in-your-name.copied_text: The abstinent CEO Fu Hanchuan, doomed to die before New Year’s Eve due to his fully Yang constitution, unexpectedly discovers that impoverished college student Shi Yue is the only one in the world with a fully Yin body capable of healing him. To survive, Fu Hanchuan marries Shi Yue. But learning that her healing him puts her life at risk, he gradually falls in love and faces a torturous choice between life and death.

hunting-love.copied_text:
To avenge her mother’s death, Wan Lin goes undercover for three years, posing as the fiancée of Fu Yan, heir to the underworld empire in Mai City. But on their wedding day, during a raid led by her own agency, Wan Lin shoots Fu Yan.

When they meet again, enemies become allies. As Wan Lin begins to see the sincerity in Fu Yan’s heart. Together, they dismantle the criminal forces from within. Vengeance eventually gives way to love, and the two step into a new life, hand in hand.

phoenix-lord.copied_text: The story follows the tumultuous yet heartfelt romance between Yun Lian and Ning Buyu. Ning Buyu, the war god of the Empire’s northern frontier, appears stern and unyielding but hides a heart full of tenderness and devotion. Yun Lian, the empress of Dayuan, brings courage, determination, and passion into their love, making it all the more vibrant. After being reborn, the two face challenges and misunderstandings from the outside world, yet they remain steadfast in their love and overcome every obstacle together.

married-to-my-crush.copied_text: On a snowy night in North City, Zhong Xiran was abandoned by her first love, Huo Xin, and entered into a marriage with Qi Sinian, who had secretly loved her for eleven years. Four years of a "cold" marriage later, with her ex-husband returning, family pressures mounting, and rumors swirling, she unexpectedly discovers that this marriage was his long-planned act of deep love and protection. When the truth is revealed, she turns and throws herself into his arms: "Let's spend the rest of our lives together."

the-love-you-gave-me.copied_text: Software engineer Min Hui and CEO Xin Qi fell in love due to a misunderstanding, only to part ways because of another. Years later, they meet again in the workplace and realize they've both returned to where their love began. From then on, their professional rivalry and personal entanglements weave a bittersweet emotional tug-of-war.

the-flame-of-love.copied_text: A life-saving marriage turns into a game of survival! To save her comatose younger brother, Shi Ning has no choice but to marry Shen Nanxun, the eldest grandson of the Shen family. However, on the engagement day, she learns of his affair with his secretary and his plan to kill her after marriage. In desperation, she turns to Shen Lingchen, the most intimidating half-son of the Shen family—and also Nanxun's rival—hoping to marry him instead. Despite seeing through her scheme of active seduction and gradual probing, the cold Lingchen repeatedly protects her. How did this battle of wits turn into love? But she cannot afford to love, as her marriage is only meant to save her brother.

clocking-in-for-love.copied_text: Zhou Cancan, a clearheaded and confident manager focused on making money, and Li Jinshu, a secretly wealthy heir who is aloof on the outside but innocent at heart, find themselves in a double identity mix-up as workplace rivals and online lovers. As they spend time together amid the everyday bustle of Chengdu, their bickering and push and pull gradually turn into mutual love.

sometimes-calm-is-deadly.copied_text: After his girlfriend Aurora Golde's tragic death, Noah Stark loses his sanity. He feigns recovery upon release from the hospital, carefully setting a web of revenge and turning Jerry Fox and Jade White against each other. When the truth comes to light, he faces justice—the cost he willingly pays for the love of his life.

a-love-beyond-secrets.copied_text: Ji Xuan is drugged by accident, and thus encounters Song Zhaoli. It disrupts Ji Xuan's originally peaceful life. Everyone thinks Ji Xuan is to climb the social ladder, but only Song Zhaoli knows this is his long-planned scheme. And then, Ji Xuan gradually uncovers the mystery amid the constant entanglement. The two embark on a relationship of extreme entanglement and mutual redemption.

inescapable-scorching-love.copied_text: Because her father was imprisoned, Su Qian pretended to cheat and broke up with her lover, Shao Hanli. Six years later, she’s a single mother struggling with the high cost of her son’s medical treatment. When they reunite, Shao Hanli is now the heir of a wealthy family. Mistaking her for a gold-digger, he repeatedly humiliates her until a DNA test reveals the truth, leaving him overwhelmed with regret.

perfect-secretary-s-love.copied_text: The witty, humorous, and clear-headed Qiu Yu excels in the workplace as the capable secretary to CEO Ji Xiangdong. Unlike the workaholic Xiangdong who is not close to his family, Yu is optimistic and blessed with loving parents. The only flaw in Yu's life is her tumultuous love life; she yearns for real love and an understanding lover. Dealing with an ex's persistence and family interference, Xiangdong's hidden feelings beneath his cold exterior finally come to light. In the whirlwind of career and love, Yu chooses her own happiness.

trapped-in-the-allure.copied_text: Tanya Abell sells her virginity at a high price to Taylor Wayne in order to raise money for her sister’s medical treatment. One year later, she bumps into him at a gathering. Taylor recognizes her and traps her against the wall. She escapes and rushes back into the private room, only to be dragged back to Taylor by Jason, who tells her that the only person who has the cure to save her sister is Taylor.

the-best-couple.copied_text:
In the neon-lit alleys, the Renxin Clinic is known for its cold-hearted and money-driven underground doctor, Mu Wan. But behind the façade lies a five-year plan, which her true target is the Dark Empire’s heir, Ma Yuting.

When he stumbles in, seriously wounded, her deadly game begins. Yet he has long seen through her revenge plot. Between manipulation and temptation, two powerful predators engage in a fierce game of strategy and seduction.

Passion ignites in their deadly confrontation. Not only is she his fate, but also the inescapable doom he cannot avoid…

a-thousand-times-for-you.copied_text: The wedding day turns into a nightmare for Chen Zi, the rich heiress, as her fiance betrays her. She goes to a bar to drink away her sorrows and gets into a fight with a thug. He Chuan comes to her rescue like a knight in shining armor. She is instantly smitten. When they cross paths again, she takes the initiative and proposes marriage. But she has no clue that this rugged mechanic has a secret life.

my-national-husband.copied_text: Qiao Anhao and Lu Jinnian faked their marriage due to Xu Jiamu's car accident, concealing their feelings. Later, they joined the crew of a film together. After navigating misunderstandings, protection, and past revelations, they finally overcame obstacles, confirmed their feelings, and got married, achieving a happy ending.

in-her-charming-grasp.copied_text: Jiang Xian willingly clung to Lin Yuanzhou and became the city’s laughingstock. Everyone thought she would marry no one but him, until they realized she only treated him as a stand-in. She loved no one and even wanted to run away. Lin Yuanzhou, once incapable of love, gradually fell for her for real, and in the end, like a madman, bound her to his side and pleaded for her love.

obsession-after-separation.copied_text: Ran Shuang, who is once the best trader on Wall Street, agrees to marry Fu Zhiheng to repay Zhiheng's financial support. After three years of marriage, the two still share no intimacy. Shuang thinks Zhiheng is pining for his childhood sweetheart Lu Mengli, when the truth is that Zhiheng is unable to have intimate contact with women because of his trauma from being abused by his nanny as a child. After repeated rejection, Shuang decides to let go and leave. Zhiheng now gradually realizes his feelings for Shuang and resolutely pursues his wife.

love-once-again-in-the-80-s.copied_text: In the previous life, Lu Zhaoyan marries the poor boy Kuang Yue but unexpectedly becomes a rich wife. On the other hand, Zhaoyan’s sister, Lu Qinning, who marries the military officer Ling Yue, goes crazy because of Ling Yue's accidental death shortly after the wedding. As Lu Qinning kills Lu Zhaoyan, Zhaoyan retaliates and kills Qinning too, and they are both reborn. Lu Qinning chooses to snatch Kuang Yue away, not knowing that Lu Zhaoyan, who is also reborn, has prevented Ling Yue's death and is living a better life...

two-poor-ceos.copied_text: Jiang Li conceals her CEO identity on a blind date, hoping to find an obedient man. Likewise, Lin Jun, the current person in charge of Chenglin Group, pretends to be poor on a blind date to avoid gold diggers. The two instantly hit it off and get married in a flash. However, they are not prepared for the many cooperations between their respective groups, and they constantly come close to being exposed...

fake-marriage-real-love.copied_text: To register her daughter's household, Xia Xingyan goes to get a marriage certificate with her boyfriend, only to be provoked by his mistress. Meanwhile, Zhan Yechen, desperate to reject a family-arranged marriage, urgently needs a temporary wife and enters a fake marriage with Xia Xingyan. Xia Xingyan soon discovers that her daughter is not her boyfriend's child, and Zhan Yechen helps her fight back. Later, Xia Xingyan's best friend, Shen Rui, pretends to be Zhan Yechen’s long-lost first love, stirring up misunderstandings. As they navigate the complications, Zhan Yechen gradually falls in love with Xia Xingyan and begins to suspect that her daughter might actually be his own.

secretly-loving-you.copied_text: Heiress He Lingfei, who once lived extravagantly, abruptly severed ties with her college boyfriend after her family went bankrupt. Unbeknownst to her, Lu Yichen was actually an abandoned heir of a wealthy family. After being cast out, he clawed his way back and transformed into a cold-hearted CEO. Years later, they reunite at a banquet where He Lingfei, now a fallen heiress, is busy serving her fiancé. Lu Yichen's eyes blaze with love and resentment: When you left me without a word back then, did you ever think about the man you discarded?

when-fish-swim-to-land.copied_text: Sun Lu, a rule-abiding elementary school teacher, harbors a rebellious desire to break free from constraints. An unexpected home visit leads her into the life of Chen Xudong, a fish store owner. In her eyes, he is a "problematic" man with a child; yet, beneath her obedient facade, he sees the same stubbornness and loneliness as his own. As prejudices dissolve, their hearts quietly draw closer in the tranquil world of the aquarium. However, Sun Lu discovers that this gentle man hides a deeply buried past. Disparities in social status and sealed secrets form a chasm between them. Can their love overcome the barriers of reality and become each other's salvation?

my-beloved-serpent.copied_text: To break the curse of dying within six months and not being reincarnated, the serpent demon Qing'er takes the deposed prince Zhao Jin as her disciple, treating him with genuine kindness. Unbeknownst to her, Zhao is inscrutable, sinister, and cruel. As he uses and tests her, he falls in love but dares not confess, leading to Qing'er's tragic death to protect him. Qing'er is reborn as the cold palace empress Wei Ji without her past memories, and reunites with Zhao, now a tyrant. Filled with regret, Zhao uses a blood curse to prolong his life to find her, only to miss her again. He disguises himself as a martial arts master Ah Jin to get close, earnestly winning her heart amid misunderstandings. Meanwhile, Zhao Ke, the regent reborn as Wei Zhongping, schemes in the shadows, seeking revenge through Qing'er. When Qing'er regains her memories, she confronts the restrains of their master-disciple and human-demon differences, seeing Zhao's sincerity through life-and-death trials. Overcoming countless obstacles, they unite, weaving a tale of undying love across two lifetimes.

in-the-snare-of-love.copied_text: To save her sister Nina from heart disease, Cheryl Snow asks Sean Hall for a cure and becomes his lover in the process. Worried that Cheryl will eventually win Sean’s heart, Sienna Zane conspires with Heath Clark to frame Cheryl, resulting in Nina’s death in the operating room. Devastated, Cheryl demands a breakup. It is then that Sean realizes he is already in love with her. Sean later investigates the circumstances surrounding Nina’s death.

winning-her-over-a-second-time.copied_text: Despite living with his girlfriend, Sally Nelson, for the past three years and being fully aware of her expectations for marriage, Quinton Young continually delays their potential marital bliss. Although it's clear to everyone that he loves Sally, he refuses to acknowledge their relationship. Eventually, Sally, frustrated by his reluctance, decides to leave him and turns to someone else for what he won’t give her.

a-contractual-marriage-hell-no.copied_text: Keira Snow wakes up in shock, realizing that she had forced herself onto Nolan Blair, the CEO of her company, the night before. Overcome with guilt and pressure, she considers quitting her job. But her heartless parents have other plans, pushing her into a marriage arrangement she has no say in. Reluctantly, Keira decides to go along with it.

his-dangerous-obsession.copied_text: Austin Gorman, the illegitimate son of a powerful family, returns from overseas service—only to find himself hunted by the directors of his family's company in a ruthless power struggle. While on the run, he crosses paths with Diane Hoover, who saves him, and that fateful night becomes the beginning of their destined love.

note-to-my-true-love.copied_text: Ji Hanyue, who long abandoned her dream of jewelry design, is trapped in a loveless marriage, enduring the silent treatment from her husband He Jiayuan and harassment from her mother-in-law. On a snowy night seeking medical help, she reunites with Jiang Peizhi, with whom she had a note-passing romance during college. Now the chairman of Jiang Group, Jiang is still in love with Ji. Upon learning of her unhappy marriage, he resolves to rescue her from the misery. He meticulously exposes He's true colors—impersonation, infidelity, and exploiting his wife for personal gain—helping Ji secure a divorce. With Jiang's support, Ji rediscovers her passion for design and stuns the industry with her butterfly-themed jewelry. Ultimately, Ji realizes her true feelings, breaks free from her past, and starts a new chapter in life with Jiang, who has waited for her for seven years.

she-came-from-the-abyss.copied_text:
In order to exact her revenge for her mother and older sister's death, Adel infiltrated the Bay family disguised as the maid Kris Frost. Her target? Jamie Suthern, who married into the Bay family. 

She gained others' trust, created conflict, seduced Tony Bay, and destroyed his marriage with Jamie. Jamie was smart, yet she was a lunatic. The two fought, and Adel was kicked out of the Bay family thrice, but she would always return.

the-unknown-man-i-call-mine.copied_text: Claire Lane marries the supposedly unattractive Linus Lyon to save her family’s business. She teams up with him to fend off malicious attacks from her own relatives and gradually gains a foothold in the company. As a mysterious figure casts doubt on Linus’s true identity, their bond deepens while they face crisis after crisis. In the end, Claire uncovers shocking secrets about her own origins and the mystery surrounding Linus.
